subject: ADR-198: the plot everyone calls 400 -- a printed figure and an exported column have to be the same measurement, and the stand sheet's expansion factor is closed
body: ADR-197 closed six page defects and FILED a seventh, because closing it moved three figures four tasks claimed; this is that slice, and the first fix carried by the protocol freeze rather than described by it. A circle of r = 11.28 m encloses 399.7312 m2. The stand sheet printed '400 m2' and 'Expansion factor 25.0' while every column computed from them used the real 25.01681, so a 30 cm stem's 0.070686 m2 came out of the CSV as 1.7683 per hectare where the printed factor gives 1.7672. A rounding you can see is not a defect; two roundings, one visible and one not, on numbers a reader is expected to multiply together, are -- and nothing caught it because the two printed figures AGREE WITH EACH OTHER: 10,000/400 is 25.0 exactly, so the sheet was internally consistent about a plot nobody measured. The page had already made this argument about the smaller plot in its own fine print -- 'r = 5.64 m is EF 100.1, not 100.0' -- and then printed that plot's area as '100 m2'. The trimming differs by term: area trims its trailing zeros to nothing so a rectangle still reads 400 and a circle reads 399.73; the factor is held to at least one decimal so a rectangle still reads 25.0, since 'EF 25' reads as a count and four task claims rest on that decimal. One figure now feeds four places -- banner, field sheet, Darwin Core sampleSizeValue and the samplingProtocol string -- because a record that says 400 in one field and 399.73 in the next is arguing with itself. THE ORACLE IS RECONCILIATION, NOT A PINNED STRING: the figures are read back off the rendered sentence and multiplied, printed area x printed factor = 10,000 within 0.005 x (area + factor), beside |printed area - pi r^2| < 0.005 at three radii -- because 400 x 25.0 satisfies the first while describing the wrong plot. And the CSV column against the PRINTED factor, which the old EF 25.0 misses by 0.0012 against a tolerance of 0.0004. Two more the same trial filed: associatedTaxa was a Darwin Core column this sheet emitted and never populated, on a sheet whose Web pane records interactions naming the species it tallies, and it now carries this occurrence's side of each edge as a sentence ('mule deer eats this taxon') because a key:taxon pair cannot say which end of the edge an occurrence sits at; and a top height off one measured stem is not a stand figure, so the sample travels beside it as its own tile rather than inside the label, since a figure whose NAME moves when the data moves cannot be followed across a session. Nine claims and the goal prose moved in page-stand-sheet-science.json and the three blind trials are unchanged, graded against the protocols frozen beside them. verify_ss 84 -> 114, verify_report 208 -> 223, verify_tasks 368 -> 371, verify_dwc 147 -> 150, mutate_report 124 -> 134.
